cover.title: How AI Agents Think: Myth vs Fact

slides.myth: AI agents only follow fixed instructions.
slides.fact: They plan and decide actions based on goals and observations.

slides.myth: AI agents always know exactly what will happen.
slides.fact: They learn by observing and updating plans with new info.

slides.myth: AI agents act once and stop.
slides.fact: They repeat planning, acting, and observing continuously to improve.

slides.heading: AI Agent Thinking Loop
slides.body: Agents plan, act, observe, then repeat to adapt and learn.
